# How to Remove Video Object with Claude MCP and Medux

Learn how to use Claude MCP and Medux to remove an object from a video by mask regions, including setup, request fields, tool approval, and results.

## Expected Medux tools

- `medux_remove_video_object`

## Prompt

```text
Remove an object from a video by mask regions.
```

## Review before approval

- `input_file_id` (required): Input video file id.
- `mask_regions` (required): Regions to remove, e.g. [[x, y, width, height]].
- `model_id` (optional): Model Default: remove-video-object-default.
- `title` (optional): Optional task title.

## Claude notes

- In claude.ai or Claude Desktop, attach inputs and enable the Medux connector for the conversation.
- In Claude Code, keep inputs in the working directory and confirm Medux with `/mcp`.
- An attachment is not a Medux `file_id`; approve the upload step when the workflow requires one.
